title: CreditBalanceSummary
description: Indicates the billing credit balance for billing credits granted to a customer.

balances.description: The billing credit balances. One entry per credit grant currency. If a customer only has credit grants in a single currency, then this will have a single balance entry.

customer.description: The customer the balance is for.

customer_account.description: The account the balance is for.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
